_about: Delay-damage rules extracted from the 12 project agreements and checked by a person. One-time setup data: update only when an agreement changes.

rules.rule_text: 0.2 Cr for each week Phase 1 finishes after its revised date, after a 3-week grace period, up to 2.5 Cr
rules.exclusions: An approved extension-of-time claim would move the revised date and reduce this

rules.rule_text: 0.2 Cr for each week Phase 2 finishes after its revised date, after a 3-week grace period, up to 2.5 Cr
rules.exclusions: An approved extension-of-time claim would move the revised date and reduce this

rules.rule_text: 0.1 Cr for each week Section B is commissioned after its revised date, after an 8-week grace period, up to 1.5 Cr
rules.exclusions: Applies to each section separately

rules.rule_text: 0.1 Cr for each week Section C is commissioned after its revised date, after an 8-week grace period, up to 1.5 Cr
rules.exclusions: Applies to each section separately

rules.rule_text: 0.1 Cr for each week Section D is commissioned after its revised date, after an 8-week grace period, up to 1.5 Cr
rules.exclusions: Applies to each section separately

rules.rule_text: 0.5% of contract value for each week handover is after the final contract date, up to 10% of contract value
rules.exclusions: Charged in addition to milestone penalties

rules.rule_text: 0.1 Cr for each week long-lead orders are placed after the revised date, after a 2-week grace period, up to 1 Cr
rules.exclusions: Internal project: the charge is paid from the project budget to the sponsoring business unit; contract value shown is the approved budget

rules.rule_text: 0.5 Cr for each week start of production is after the revised date, no grace period, up to 5 Cr
rules.exclusions: Passed on from the customer supply agreement for the new model launch

rules.rule_text: 0.3 Cr for each week rated output is reached after the revised date, after a 2-week grace period, up to 3 Cr
rules.exclusions: Rated output means 3 consecutive shifts at design speed

rules.rule_text: 0.2 Cr for each week the structure is completed after the revised date, after a 1-week grace period, up to 2 Cr

rules.applies_to: Cold rooms ready for first stock intake

rules.rule_text: 0.25% of budget for each week handover is after the final contract date, up to 5% of budget
rules.exclusions: Charged in addition to the other charges

rules.rule_text: 0.05 Cr for each week the permit is late because of late or incomplete submissions, after a 2-week grace period, up to 0.5 Cr
rules.exclusions: No charge for delay caused by the authority. Internal project: the charge is paid from the project budget to the sponsoring business unit; contract value shown is the approved budget

rules.rule_text: 0.5% of contract value for each week handover is after the final contract date, up to 10% of contract value
